'''Marie Georges Humbert''' (7 January 1859 Paris, France – 22 January 1921  Paris, France) was a French mathematician who worked on [[Kummer surface]]s and the [[Appell–Humbert theorem]] and introduced [[Humbert surface]]s. His son was the mathematician [[Pierre Humbert (mathematician)|Pierre Humbert]]. He won the [[Poncelet Prize]] of the  [[Académie des Sciences]] in 1891.

He studied at the [[École Polytechnique]]. He was the [[brother-in-law]] of [[Charles Mangin]].
